children: RMX Industries entered into a securities purchase agreement with Vanquish Funding Group for a 12% promissory note with $295,550 in principal, issued for a purchase price of $257,000. The note matures October 15, 2027, and the company may prepay it in full without penalty; the agreement also contemplates up to $1.1 million in additional financing over the next 12 months, subject to further agreement. Proceeds are intended for general working capital, and conversion into shares is permitted only following a continuing event of default and subject to stated restrictions.
